Part of [[Ms. Charm]]'s Bad News quest to get a perfume from [[Miss Chain]]. [[Miss Chain]] Will ask you to deliver this basket to [[Clotho]] in the swamp, she'll tell you she doesn't like apples. You now need 12 frogs to give to Miss Chain. [[Clotho]] can sell you 10 frogs.
